sentences.text: Alec Sokolow is an American film writer who has worked on such projects as the movies Cheaper by the Dozen , Toy Story , Money Talks , and Garfield : The Movie .	film writer	film writer	Cheaper by the Dozen	Cheaper by the Dozen (2003 film)	Toy Story	Toy Story	Money Talks	Money Talks (1997 film)
He frequently works with Joel Cohen .	Joel Cohen	Joel Cohen (writer)

Along with Joss Whedon , Andrew Stanton , John Lasseter , Pete Docter , Joe Ranft , and Cohen , Sokolow was nominated in 1995 for the Academy Award for Best Writing -LRB- Original Screenplay -RRB- for his work on Toy Story .
